tests.title: sidebar collapse keeps labels and child history, resets per session, and public pages have no app menu
mobile menu supports Escape, focus, short-screen scroll and resize without hidden controls
public and internal 404 recover differently, and unauthenticated app URLs first require login
pricing signup and onboarding restore the original plan and keep later plan histories independent
template login returns to the same public template and restores only its email draft
invoice login restores stable rows and exact amount, allows editing, and does not replay on browser return
protected destination survives signup, optional verification and every onboarding step
landing, introduction and blog email CTAs return through login; support and legal stay in their own boundaries
company modal separates address draft, logo and overall save, supports failure retry, and updates the same dashboard company
saved public profile off persists after logout, leaves the slug and shared preview intact, and restores on re-enable
real local logo decoding rejects invalid input, retries, removes in-flight files and releases object URLs on close
settings read states, permission, cancellation and scope switches cannot publish stale or foreign drafts
